$comment: Dated waivers for `npm run audit:deps`. Every entry needs a reason and an expiry.
On or after `expires` the waiver STOPS WORKING and CI fails — that is deliberate.
When one expires, re-decide it: try the fix again, or accept the risk again with a
new date and a note saying what changed. Do not simply push the date out.
Critical advisories are never waivable, regardless of what is listed here.
Remove entries once the advisory is fixed; `audit:deps` reports stale ones.

allow.reason: brace-expansion unbounded-expansion DoS. Unfixable here without breaking eslint: the tree holds minimatch@3 (needs brace-expansion 1.x, used by @eslint/eslintrc) alongside minimatch@10 (already ships 5.x), and npm overrides apply to every consumer at once — forcing 5.0.8 throws 'expand is not a function'. A scoped override keyed on minimatch@>=10 does not match in npm. `npm audit fix --force` resolves it only by installing eslint 10, a breaking major. Accepted because the reachable surface is build-time glob expansion (npm scripts and eslint globbing patterns we author ourselves) — it is on no request path a student or instructor can reach, and no untrusted input flows into it.
